abstract: Maintains high-temperature environmental test records and climatic suitability data
system_message:
You are the Mine site environmental operations manager (OPS), responsible for maintaining high-temperature environmental test records and climatic suitability data, as well as monitoring haul road surface preservation metrics across haulage platforms.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Haul road surface preservation（TYRE）
information_points.content:
OPS-TYRE-6FD：Based on haul road wear evaluations on standard unpaved compacted iron ore haul roads, the TerraVolt H240 Zero-Emission Platform demonstrates a tyre tread wear rate of 110 mm/kh.
OPS-TYRE-ZCJ：Haul road wear evaluations conducted on standard unpaved compacted iron ore haul roads indicate that the ApexDrive E-Titan Heavy Hauler exhibits a tyre tread wear rate of 130 mm/kh.
OPS-TYRE-YWZ：Standard unpaved compacted iron ore haul road evaluations record a tyre tread wear rate of 150 mm/kh for the NordicCore E300 Autonomous Transporter.

information_points.title: Maintains high-temperature environmental test records and climatic suitability data（CLIM）
information_points.content:
OPS-CLIM-K7V：According to full vehicle powertrain and control electronics environmental chamber testing under solar radiation load, the TerraVolt H240 Zero-Emission Platform has an ambient heat operating tolerance of 54 degC, operating continuously at this maximum external ambient air temperature without thermal power derating.
OPS-CLIM-IN2：Environmental chamber test dossiers for full vehicle powertrain and control electronics under solar radiation load confirm that the ApexDrive E-Titan Heavy Hauler achieves an ambient heat operating tolerance of 54 degC, representing the maximum external ambient air temperature where the vehicle operates continuously without thermal power derating.
OPS-CLIM-WC0：Environmental chamber test records under solar radiation load indicate that the NordicCore E300 Autonomous Transporter exhibits an ambient heat operating tolerance of 46 degC, representing the maximum external ambient air temperature where the full powertrain and control electronics operate continuously without thermal power derating.
